Sharon Lead Acquisition System

A walkthrough for acquiring insurance customer leads and sales agent recruiting leads from real acquisition channels, social content, dedicated pages, and compliance-aware review.

Acquisition System

Two Lead Streams With One Approval Layer

The system separates customer acquisition from recruiting, then routes both streams through guided qualification and human approval.

  • Separate page for insurance customers
  • Separate page for sales agent recruiting
  • Lead source plan for Meta, Google Search, LinkedIn, content, and referrals
  • Social Hub with account enrollment, stats, content deployment, and lead scans
  • Compliance watch for acquisition guidance
  • AEO Studio for buyer and sales agent search questions
  • Guided intake with human approval before routing
  • Clickable command cards, scheduling, and profile customization
  • Resizable sidebar and lightweight app-wide motion

Dashboard

Lead Acquisition Command Center

The command center shows both lead streams, pending approvals, and approved opportunities in one place.

  • Insurance customer lead count
  • Sales agent recruiting lead count
  • Clickable cards route to the right stored lead area

Lead Sources

Real Channels Feeding The System

The acquisition plan uses the best mix for Sharon’s two goals: buyer demand and sales agent recruiting.

  • Insurance buyers from Meta ads, Google Search Ads, local content, and referral partners
  • Sales agent candidates from LinkedIn, career search demand, and recruiting content
  • Every response routes into intake, approval, scheduling, and reporting

Scheduling

Calendar, Notes, And Outcomes

The schedule view gives the team one place to plan callbacks, recruiting conversations, and follow-up outcomes.

  • Calendar-style follow-up cards
  • Date, time, notes, and outcome selector
  • Approved metric routes directly into this workspace

Lead Manager

Stored Leads Split By Buyer And Recruit Type

The lead manager separates customer/client opportunities from sales agent candidates so each stream can use the right status, follow-up, links, reporting, and content plan.

  • Customers / Clients sub-nav
  • Sales Agents sub-nav
  • Relevant workflow data for each lead type

Insurance Customers

Dedicated Customer Acquisition Page

This page captures people looking for life insurance, mortgage protection, family coverage, or business continuity help.

  • Consumer-focused messaging
  • Protection review request form
  • Submissions feed guided intake and approval

Sales Agent Recruiting

Dedicated Recruitment Page

This page captures people interested in licensing, agency support, mentorship, or joining the sales team.

  • Recruiting-focused messaging
  • Experience and license-status intake
  • Submissions route into recruiting approval

Social Hub

Connected Account Stats, Publishing, And Lead Scans

The Social Hub brings business accounts into one view, shows which platforms create attention, and explains that campaign accounts must be enrolled before recurring lead scans can run.

  • Tabbed stats by platform
  • Views, engagements, clicks, and leads
  • Buyer and recruiting content cards with destination links
  • Prompt appears if no social accounts are attached
  • Engagement routing into intake for review

Compliance Watch

Current Guidance Before Campaign Changes

The monitor checks trusted sources for acquisition and advertising guidance before new lead tactics go live.

  • NAIC, FINRA, FTC, and FCC source watchlist
  • Topics matched to customer and recruiting acquisition
  • Human review before changing scripts or outreach

AEO Studio

Search Questions Become Lead Paths

The AEO Studio turns real buyer and recruiting questions into answer snippets, campaign hooks, and direct routes to the right acquisition page.

  • Consumer questions route to the insurance customer page
  • Opportunity questions route to the recruitment page
  • Compliance watch supports review before publishing

Human Approval

Approval Before Automation Acts

The system keeps the human approval step before a reply, booking invitation, or recruiting action goes out.

  • Review lead summary
  • Approve or reject the recommendation
  • Route approved leads into the right pipeline

Interface Updates

Polished Controls For Daily Use

The latest interface pass makes the system feel more like a live operating tool than a static presentation.

  • Profile menu opens from Sharon’s avatar or name
  • Default portrait is committed to GitHub and shared publicly
  • Sidebar is resizable on desktop
  • Lightweight motion is app-wide and respects reduced-motion settings

Reporting

Lead Acquisition Scorecard

The reporting view shows captured leads, approval status, fit score, and the automation flow.

  • Total captured across both streams
  • Average fit score and approval volume
  • Flow from captured to approved or rejected
